info.title: Open Horizon API
info.description: Observability + orchestration API for long-horizon distributed RL.

EventEnvelope.description:
One row of the durable event log. `seq` is monotonic per store so
clients can resume a WebSocket with `?since=<seq>`.

EventMeta.description:
Fields every event carries. Flattened into each variant so the wire
shape is `{kind, event_id, at, run_id, ...payload}`, matching what the
dashboard already consumes.

JobRecord.description:
A leased unit of work. Rollouts and training runs are both jobs so a
crash mid-run leaves a row another worker can pick up after the lease
expires, instead of an orphaned in-memory task.

horizon.description: When absent, the configured round scheduler decides the horizon.

policy_profile.description: Named policy profile. Absent = the configured default profile.

has_training_metadata.description: Flips true when a `TurnTrainingRecord` row exists for this step.

TurnTrainingRecord.description:
Per-turn token-level metadata, stored in its own table so run payloads
never carry the bytes.
